description: Not everything deserves the same level of output #selflove #selfimprovement #selfpreservation
transcript: I've learned to be mindful of my input because not everything deserves the same level of care. The more that I sit in the fact that time is limited and with the limited amount of time that I have, I can only focus on small steps at a time. There are instances in which I have to take large steps, but I'm mindful of my direction and I'm mindful of my pace because I value my time. Why? Because there's not much of it.
